transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I've got the urgent bracket order on my desk and I need to move on it. Before I make the production authorization, I need to walk through my standard pre-run gate agenda. I understand refurbished stamping die D-18 is available, and Press 2 is currently the planned machine. However, I'm also aware that Press 5 is idle through the end of the week if we need an alternative. Before I make my go/no-go call, I need to hear from maintenance and quality engineering: are there any unresolved technical or release conditions I need to be aware of before I record the authorization and release this order?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Elena, I need to flag a critical technical issue before you make your go/no-go call. The refurbishment shop's fit report, which I received by email yesterday but haven't yet entered in the maintenance work order, shows that D-18's lower shoe is incompatible with Press 2 due to a 0.25 mm bolster mismatch. The die is only compatible with Press 5. Additionally, installing the replacement guide-post set on Press 5 will take exactly 6 hours.
